body.x: Clobot (CEO Chang-gu Kim) participated in the “2024 Future Innovation tech eXpo (FIX 2024)” held from October 23 to October 26 at Daegu EXCO. Since its founding in 2017, Clobot has been recognized for its expertise in developing indoor autonomous robots, focusing on robotic software and services. Leveraging partnerships with global robotics brands, Clobot provides integrated hardware and software solutions across various industries.

At FIX 2024, Clobot featured the high-performance quadruped robot ‘Spot’ from Boston Dynamics, which the company imports and sells in Korea. Spot is known for its agility and stability on diverse terrains, including flat ground, rough paths, and stairs. It can climb up to 30° slopes, avoid obstacles, and plan routes, performing complex tasks in challenging environments with safety and precision.

Spot’s modular design allows it to carry sensors, cameras, and other mission-specific equipment, supporting up to 14 kg of payload for transport tasks. It also supports remote control and pre-programmed autonomous operations, making it ideal for replacing human workers in hazardous environments. A cloud-based management system can monitor and control the robot in real-time.

body.cap: Spot demonstrating its mobility at the event | Photo by AVING News

body.x: A Clobot representative noted, “Spot’s versatility and durability make it highly valuable across various industrial fields. Its network-based multi-control capabilities and seamless integration with automation systems further enhance its appeal.”

The representative added, “Through our partnership with Boston Dynamics, we’re introducing this cutting-edge robotic technology to the Korean market. With the robotics sector’s rapid growth, we see this exhibition as a platform to drive business expansion and capture interest in Spot’s innovative capabilities.”

body.cap: Clobot’s booth at FIX 2024 | Photo by AVING News

body.x: FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
